original_instruction:
I want to test my e-commerce website. Please check the entire user journey 
    from landing page to checkout, looking for any issues with navigation, 
    product selection, cart functionality, and payment process. Also check 
    for mobile responsiveness and accessibility compliance.

improved_prompt.goal: Comprehensive e-commerce website user experience testing

tasks: Validate accessibility (screen reader compatibility, color contrast)
Check image loading and zoom capabilities

system_prompt_used:
You rewrite raw user requests into precise,
observable computer-use tasks. 
Clarify the goal, page URL, target selector, and measurable outcomes.
Return JSON with improved_prompt.
